desc:
Welcome to PIGSHOT, the most chaotic pig shooter on Roblox! Grab a gun, grapple across the map and battle other pigs in fast duels where the first to win 3 rounds takes the match!

🎉 NEW GAME - Thanks for playing PIGSHOT! More maps, weapons and cosmetics are on the way! 🐷

🔫 Take on other pigs in quick round-based duels!
🪝 Swing with your grappling hook, double jump, flip and slide around every map!
🗺️ Vote for your map and fight across castles, desert ruins, shipping docks and more!
💰 Earn coins every match and spend them in the shop!
👑 Unlock shirts, pants, hats and crowns to make your pig look fresh!
📜 Complete daily tasks for extra rewards!

👍 Like and favorite the game to get notified about new updates!

⚠️ WARNING: Cheaters will be permanently banned. Exploiting glitches is not allowed!
